name: mall-demo-mysql-orders-incremental
description: Zero-code incremental MySQL Query capture from observability-demo selfheal.demo_orders table using composite (created_at, order_id) cursor, enriched with mall_vip_catalog and fanned out to Guance DataWay + downstream sink.

config.query: SELECT order_id, sku, quantity, amount_cent, status, key_request, business_request_id, user_id, created_at, updated_at FROM demo_orders WHERE (created_at > {{cursor}}) OR (created_at = {{cursor}} AND order_id > {{tie_breaker}}) ORDER BY created_at ASC, order_id ASC LIMIT {{limit}}

pipeline.script:
lookup("mall_vip_catalog", user_id)
set_tag("project", "mall-demo")
set_tag("service", "mall-mysql-orders")
set_tag("order_status", status)
if user_tier != "" {
    set_tag("user_tier", user_tier)
}
